0022600185.text: The Lakers (5-2, 1st in the Pacific and 4th in the West) take a 2-1 road record and a win streak into this matchup, while the Sacramento Kings are 0-6, 5th in the Pacific and 15th in the West. This is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season, following a 2025-26 series the Lakers won 3-1, and their most recent game was a 128-104 Lakers win in Los Angeles on March 1, 2026. The Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), and the Kings are without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee).
